question_record.context: As part of a security incident where multiple known public tools, which could be used for malicious reasons, were dropped on this device, we observed various processes such as `mimikatz.exe`, `powershell.exe`, and `psexec.exe` being executed. One of the processes involved, `domaindominance27.ps1`, was run using PowerShell. This incident likely involves credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.
question_record.question: Can you provide the command line associated with the execution of the known credential theft tool detected in this incident?
solution: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped on the device using account with SID `S-5-7-21-1843151660-3234030288-105586167-1422`.

A malicious credential theft tool (mimikatz) was executed with the command line `mimikatz.exe lsadump::dcsync /domain:vnevado.alpineskihouse.co /user:xfbzkp exit` at `2024-06-27t14:33:38.0249949z`, with Process ID `4748`.

62.name: Multiple dual-purpose tools were dropped
62.description:
Multiple known public tools, which could also be used for malicious reasons were dropped on this device.
Attackers might download or copy multiple dual-purpose tools to the target device to perform various attack stages including, credential theft, privilege escalation, and lateral movement.

26.name: Malicious credential theft tool execution detected
26.description:
A known credential theft tool execution command line was detected.
Either the process itself or its command line indicated an intent to dump users' credentials, keys, plain-text passwords and more.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

steps.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Command_File_Mention' AND o.Concept = 'Account_SID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s,%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT o.AlertId, o.AlertTitle, o.ObservedAt, o.EntityIndex,
       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_SID' AND o.Concept = 'Process_Identity'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
